newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mostly down, blue chips up.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mostly down, blue chips up.

text.p: Croatian stock were mostly lower in lively trade on Tuesday with blue chips bucking the trend.
* Six of 11 active issues fell, three rose and two were flat.
* Volume 9,852 units, turnover doubled to 10.2 million kuna.
* Biggest gainer chocolate maker Kras inched up 15 kuna to 465 on volume of 105 shares.
* Biggest decliner hotelier Istraturist lost 15 kuna to 155 on volume of 61 shares.
* Most active stock fully-listed Zagrebacka Banka gained 220 kuna to 1,840 with 3,948 shares sold.
